meta.name: product-launch-video
meta.description: Turn a product or marketing URL, pasted script, or brief into a product launch / promo video — SaaS promos, feature reveals, product demos, app and company launches. Use when the user wants to market, launch, promote, or reveal a product; the default for any commercial URL. Site tours / showcases of a website route here too — the brief carries the show-it-as-is intent. Unclear → /hyperframes.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 生成产品发布宣传视频，输入网址或脚本
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你有产品网址或脚本，想生成宣传视频
copy.tagline_en: Turn a product URL or script into a launch promo video
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you have a product URL or script and want to generate a promo video

howto.what: 装上后,当你给它一个产品链接、网址或一段文案,它会先抓取网页素材,再按步骤生成一个产品宣传视频的分镜脚本、画面文件,最后渲染成视频。
howto.when: 当你要求为一个产品、网站或 App 做宣传、推广、发布视频,或提交一个商业网址时触发;不确定时它会转给 /hyperframes 处理。

say.text: 帮我根据这个链接做一条产品发布宣传视频:https://example.com
say.note: 它会抓取该页面素材并开始制作视频。

say.text: 把这段产品介绍文案做成一个宣传视频
say.note: 它会保存文案并生成对应的分镜和成片。

say.text: 给我的网站做一个展示视频
say.note: 它会按真实网页截图来制作,而非重建网站。

howto.what_en: It turns a product URL, pasted script, or brief into a launch/promo video by capturing the site, building a storyboard and frames, then rendering a final video.
howto.when_en: Use when the user wants to market, launch, promote, or reveal a product, or gives a commercial URL / site tour request. Uncertainty routes to /hyperframes.

say_en.text: Make a launch video from this link: https://example.com
say_en.note: It captures the page and starts production.

say_en.text: Turn this product script into a promo video
say_en.note: It saves the script and generates storyboard + final video.

say_en.text: Create a showcase video for my website
say_en.note: It uses real screenshots instead of rebuilding the site.
